title: NHAI (India) — EPC widening of NH-54 in Makhu Town, Punjab: Instructions to Bidder for e-Tendering (2024)
labelled_by: Claude (AI-assisted), line by line against the parser output; independent human review pending
notes: National Highways Authority of India, central government highway EPC tender, 2024. Complete 6-page e-tendering instructions. Publicly posted Indian government tender. Reuse terms for tender documents are unclear (GODL covers datasets), so only the answer key is stored here; run `python -m evals.fetch` to rebuild the text locally from the official source.

requirements.quote: It is mandatory for all the Bidders to have class-III Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
DSC should be in the name of the authorized signatory as authorized in Appendix III
The Bidder shall submit document in support of the class III DSC
The Authorized Signatory holding Power of Attorney (POA) or the person executing/delegating such POA shall only be the Digital Signatory
it is mandatory for the bidders to get registered their firm / Joint Venture with e-tendering portal of NHAI
Registration should be valid at least up to the date of submission of BID
bidders have to pay a sum of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand only) as a cost of the RFP process (non-refundable)
Bid must be submitted online only through e-procurement portal of NHAI
on or before 28.08.2024 (upto 1100 hours IST)
scanned in different files (in PDF or RAR format such that file size is not more than 30 MB)
Appendix IA (Letter comprising the Technical Bid) including Annexure-I to VI and supporting certificates / documents
Power of Attorney for signing the BID as per the format at Appendix-III
Power of Attorney for Lead Member of Joint Venture as per the format at Appendix-IV
Joint Bidding Agreement for Joint Venture as per the format at
BID Security of Rs. 46.29 lakh (Rupees forty six lakh twenty nine thousand only) in the form of Insurance Surety Bond
Proof of online payment towards the cost of Bid document of Rs. 10,000/-
the Integrity Pact (IP) duly signed by Authorised signatory shall be submitted by the Bidder with the RFP Bid
An undertaking from the person having PoA referred to in Sub. Clause-(b) above that they agree and abide by the Bid documents
Annexure-VIII of Appendix – IA showing details of all ongoing project works
Copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Bidder or of each Member
Copies of duly audited complete annual accounts of the Bidder or of each member (in case of Joint Venture) for preceding 5 years
Copy of originals of experience certificates apostile at foreign origin, if any
Certificate regarding Compliance with Restrictions under Rule 144 (xi) of the General Financial Rules (GFRs)
Copy of Registration from the Competent Authority as defined in Public Procurement Order No. F. No. 6/18/2019-PPD
Appendix-IB (Letter comprising the Financial Bid) shall be submitted online
Self- certification by the Bidder that its Bid meets the Local Content requirement
shall have to provide a Certificate from the Statutory Auditor or Cost Auditor of the Company
Original (in Envelope) by the Lowest Bidder before issuance of Letter of Acceptance (LOA)
Account Payee demand draft or Banker’s Cheque are submitted physically latest within 5 working days of the Bid Due Date
shall be placed in an envelope, which shall be sealed
The envelope shall clearly bear the identification
The Bidder shall upload scanned copies of the documents as specified in point nos. 2(ii)(A)&(B) above

traps.quote: The amendments / clarifications to the BID document, if any, will be hosted on the NHAI website
traps.why: Obligation or right of the procuring authority, not the bidder

traps.quote: The Bidder may modify, substitute or withdraw its e- BID after submission prior to the BID Due Date
The Authority shall open documents of the Bid received in electronic form
traps.why: Obligation or right of the procuring authority, not the bidder
